description.value: Golden Ears Farm is a farm-direct retail operation on VLA Road in the Okanagan-Thompson interior of British Columbia. As a farm shop, it likely offers locally grown produce and seasonal goods directly to customers. Touring cyclists in this rural corridor may find it a worthwhile stop for fresh local food.
